name: Sir Roderick
description: A scarred knight in a weathered crimson cloak who guards the living roads against the restless dead.
biography:
Roderick earned his spurs escorting winter supply trains through the border marshes. Years later, when the dead rose beneath his garrison, he opened the keep's postern gate and held the passage while the villagers escaped. At dawn, the survivors found him at the roadside with a split breastplate and the gate key still tied to his belt.

He buried his company and kept watch on the road they had died defending. Travelers know him by his faded crimson cloak and the habit of walking the last mile beside anyone traveling alone. When the graves stir again, he sends word to the villages himself. He knows how long it takes a family to pack a cart.
